name: play-clip-button
title: Play clip button
description: A round button that plays a short sound, such as a pronunciation or a sample, with a progress ring, one clip at a time and no audio loaded until it is pressed.
docs: src is the sound and label is the name of the button as a sentence: 'Play pronunciation of cheese'. The audio element is created on the first press, so a page of these loads no audio until one is used. Starting a clip stops any other that is playing, through a shared registry. The button is a toggle with aria-pressed, shows a spinner while the file arrives and 'Could not play' under the button, with a retry arrow, when it cannot; a second press asks for the file again, so a flaky network recovers without a reload. onEnded fires when a clip plays to its end. The ring keeps showing progress under reduced motion and only drops the easing.
